scope: Independent displacement-controlled material tests; no robot, no dressing trajectory, not calibrated to measured samples

protocol.loading: Smooth displacement-controlled front belly patch, then zero-velocity release; opposing back support retained unless --free-back; no applied-force calibration
protocol.cloth_loading: Gravity-driven drape from an initially flat sheet; only two original corners fixed

material_response.model: compressible tetrahedral filling with an existing stronger surface edge network
material_response.volume_constraint: J = signed current tetrahedron volume / rest volume; C = J - 1
material_response.multiplier_reset: once per substep, retained across contact volume re-solves
material_response.jacobi_constraint_relaxation: bulk_relaxation / maximum incident tetrahedra at the four nodes

internal_damping.model: degree-normalized axial relative-velocity impulses on disjoint edge colors

cotton_air_drag.model: isotropic quadratic particle drag weighted by barycentric rest area

cotton_membrane.model: tension-only finite extension of existing woven-cloth mesh edges
cotton_membrane.material_axes: original horizontal cloth X=warp, Y=weft; other edges=bias
cotton_membrane.solver: inverse-mass-weighted in-place projections on disjoint edge colors
cotton_membrane.coupled_constraint_residual: finite sweeps and later bending/contact may exceed bounds; inspect measure()
